init_logging: initialize logging to a file path with file and console handlers for test framework output
log_message: log an info level message to the configured logger or print to stdout if logger is not initialized
log_error: log an error level message to the configured logger or print to stdout if logger is not initialized
create_case_event: create a threading event for synchronizing test case runner execution across threads
set_and_get_value: set and get key value pairs in a global dictionary for sharing state between test functions
